note: T6 conference calendar. A date is filled in only when it was read from the society's own page; source_url (and date_sources per field) records where. Milestones: abstract_open/close/notification/release and late_breaker_open/close/notification/release -- *_release is the embargo lift. A milestone the society has not published stays null and the internal report lists it as 未公布. An entry with "verified": false is inert: liver_intel.conference refuses to open a window or tag an item from it.

conferences.note: Denver, Colorado. Meeting dates from /tlm-26/event-registration ("taking place November 5-9 in Denver, Colorado"). Read 2026-09-17 from AASLD's own pages: /tlm-26/late-breaking-abstract-submissions-tlm26 says "Submission portal opens: Monday, Sept. 15" and "Submission deadline: Friday, Sept. 25" (no year on the page; taken as 2026 -- note 15 Sept 2026 is a Tuesday, so the page's weekday is stale or the date is; the deadline's weekday is consistent), and "original abstract deadline of May 28, 2026". /tlm-26/embargo-policy: "Press Embargo for Regular Abstracts lifts on Oct. 5, 2026 at 8:00 AM MT. Publication of regular abstracts will occur on the same day" and "Late-Breaking Abstract Embargo lifts on Thursday, Nov. 5, 2026, at 8:00 AM MT". Regular abstract opening and both notification dates were not on any page read (the abstracts page returns 410 now that submissions are closed) -- left null, not guessed.
